summary: You have developed an engaging mission concept for monitoring Australian coral bleaching, effectively supported by STK simulations and architecture trade-offs. To reach the Accomplished level across your design, focus on resolving key technical discrepancies—such as your orbital inclination and launch coordinates—and explicitly distinguishing formal operators from customers. Additionally, elevate your report presentation by adopting standard academic referencing, adding figure captions, and thoroughly proofreading incomplete text.
next_steps: Revisit orbital mechanics and geographic parameters to correct technical values, ensuring your SSO inclination is retrograde (~97.8°) and Kourou's latitude is accurately defined (~5.2°N).
Formalize your stakeholder analysis in the Introduction by explicitly defining the spacecraft operating entity separately from specific end-user and customer organizations.
Upgrade report presentation by replacing Wikipedia links with peer-reviewed sources, fully formatting bibliography citations, numbering and captioning all figures, and completing truncated sentences.

To reach Accomplished, explicitly differentiate the spacecraft operator from the customer organizations in your Introduction, and strengthen the background context with more thorough literature citations.
criteria.C2: You effectively applied STK access analyses and trade-offs across your mission design sections. To achieve Accomplished, verify technical calculations and parameters for consistency: correct Kourou's latitude in Mission Design (~5.2°N), ensure the 600 km SSO inclination is retrograde (~97.8°), and convert contact times accurately (580.8 s is ~9.7 minutes, not twenty).
criteria.C3: Your conclusion neatly connects your launch vehicle, sun-synchronous orbit, and the Mt Pleasant ground station back to the coral monitoring objectives. To reach Accomplished, move beyond descriptive summaries by incorporating critical evaluation of design limitations, operational mission risks, and concrete engineering recommendations.
criteria.C4: Your report maintains an accessible structure with clear headings. To meet Accomplished standards, replace prohibited Wikipedia links with complete academic citations instead of bare URLs, number and caption all figures and tables, and proofread to eliminate unfinished sentences, such as the cut-off text in Mission Duration & EOL.
